tools.name: check_reporting_obligation
tools.description: Checks whether CSRD reporting applies to a company after the 2026 EU simplification, whether the voluntary VSME standard and the value-chain cap are relevant, and whether the Dutch CO2-Prestatieladder matters. Uses headcount and turnover; no account needed.

tools.name: explain_disclosure
tools.description: Returns the official text of a disclosure in the EU voluntary standard for SMEs (VSME, B1-B11 and C1-C9) or in the ESRS (2026 edition, for example E1-8 or S1-5), with its EUR-Lex link. ESRS text is available in English, Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Polish.
